The site half of contenir/contenir-audience for Mezzio: a Subscriptions service a sign-up handler calls, which writes the sign-up to the add-on's outbox in the site's database, wired from the same bindings the CMS add-on reads.
The Campaign Monitor add-on for Contenir CMS: keeps a Campaign Monitor list in step with the site's sign-ups and records, through an outbox, and hears back about unsubscribes and bounces.
The Mailchimp add-on for Contenir CMS: keeps a Mailchimp audience in step with the site's sign-ups and records, through an outbox, and hears back about unsubscribes, cleaned addresses and complaints.
